Wonderful Stay at Hotel Golden Oasis (10–17 December)

I had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Golden Oasis from 10th to 17th December. The overall experience was excellent and truly comfortable.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, with all essential amenities provided. Housekeeping did a great job every day, ensuring a fresh and welcoming environment. The staff were extremely courteous, professional, and always ready to help with a smile, which made the stay even more enjoyable.

The hotel’s location is convenient and peaceful, making it ideal for both relaxation and work. The food was tasty and well-prepared, offering good variety and quality throughout the stay.

Overall, Hotel Golden Oasis exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, clean, and friendly place to stay, and I would definitely choose to stay here again in the future.

negative_snippets: The photos must be from when the hotel was built because I went there today and it certainly does NOT look like the photos. The rooms stink of mould/mildew and they are very dirty, the ENTIRE room is. Especially the headboards of the beds, I swap 2 rooms and it was the same. I am from Australia and our lowest prices hotels are 10 times cleaner than this. The hotel staff were quite friendly and helpful to allow me to look however.
